title: 老虎来了
setting: A mountain village at dusk, on the night of the temple fair.

farmer.name: 大爷
farmer.en: a farmer with a shoulder pole

caught.narr: The tiger knocks you flat. It leans in close...
caught.zh: 老虎把你扑倒，凑了过来……

caught.en: Excuse me, which way to the temple fair?
Caught, by a tiger that only wanted directions.

steps.narr: Dusk in a mountain village. Something striped is moving in the bamboo.
steps.zh: 天快黑了，竹林里有东西在动。

steps.narr: A tiger. Coming straight at you.

say.tip: 救命 jiùmìng, literally 'save a life', is the shout for help. 啊 turns it into a cry.

mistakes.note: 帮助 is 'help' on a form. In danger, shout 救命!

steps.narr: A courtyard gate, shut. Someone's inside.

say.tip: 快 + verb = do it, fast! 快开门 = open up, quick! Same with 快走, 快跑, 快来.

steps.narr: The tiger comes in right behind you. Out the back door!
A narrow bridge. A farmer is crossing it, two buckets on a pole.
steps.zh: 小桥上，大爷挑着两桶水。

say.tip: 让 ràng = give way. 让一让 or 让一下 is 'coming through, please'; 让开 is the rude 'out of my way'.

mistakes.note: 对不起 is a real apology. To squeeze past, say 让一让 (or 不好意思，让一下).

steps.narr: A man leaning on a bike, cracking sunflower seeds.
steps.zh: 路边一个大叔扶着车，嗑着瓜子。

say.gloss: Lend me your bike a sec!
say.tip: 借我 = lend me. 一下 softens any request: 借我一下, 用一下, 骑一下, 看一下.

mistakes.note: 借给你 means 'lend it to you'. You want 借我 (lend me).

ok.en: Take it! It's got no brakes, mind!

say.tip: 刹不住 shā bu zhù = can't stop. Verb + 不住 = can't hold it: 刹不住, 忍不住, 记不住.

ok.narr: Into a haystack. Unhurt. Keep running!

fail.en: Brake with your feet! Your feet!

steps.narr: An auntie is filming the whole thing on her phone.
steps.zh: 一个大妈举着手机在拍。

say.en: Get her to call the police!
say.tip: 报警 bàojǐng = call the police. The number is 110, read 幺幺零 yāo yāo líng: in phone numbers 一 is yāo.

ok.zh: 报了报了！家人们点个赞！

fail.zh: 家人们，看这位跑得多快！
fail.en: Folks, look how fast this one's running!

steps.narr: The temple fair: drums, lanterns, and a crowd to hide in.
steps.zh: 庙会到了，锣鼓喧天，人山人海。

steps.narr: The tiger skids to a stop beside you, and takes off its head.
steps.zh: 老虎在你身边停下，摘下了头套。
对不起对不起！吓着你了吧？
steps.en: Sorry, sorry! Did I scare you?

steps.zh: 我是来庙会表演的，快迟到了！
steps.en: I'm performing at the fair, and I'm nearly late!

steps.zh: 我没追你，咱俩就是顺路！
steps.en: I wasn't chasing you. We were just going the same way!

say.en: Tell him he scared you half to death.
say.tip: 吓死我了 xià sǐ wǒ le = (you) scared me to death. Verb + 死了 means 'so very': 累死了, 饿死了, 笑死我了.

steps.en: Who called the police? Where's the tiger?
Escaped. The tiger gives the police a statement, paws and all.
steps.zh: 老虎穿着老虎服，做了笔录。
